title: Develop a service pricing strategy
description: Compare pricing approaches against delivery costs, customer value and operational limits.
accomplishes: Compare pricing approaches against delivery costs, customer value and operational limits. Provide assumptions, package boundaries and a validation plan. Explain trade-offs without inventing competitor prices or presenting a proposal as established willingness to pay.
prompt:
Act as a business strategy adviser.

Task: Develop a service pricing strategy.

Input context:
- SERVICE: [SERVICE]
- CUSTOMERS: [CUSTOMERS]
- COSTS: [COSTS]
- CAPACITY: [CAPACITY]

Compare pricing approaches against delivery costs, customer value and operational limits. Provide assumptions, package boundaries and a validation plan. Explain trade-offs without inventing competitor prices or presenting a proposal as established willingness to pay.

Distinguish verified facts, assumptions and scenarios. Example values are not verified market data.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Workshop pricing proposal
Compare a fixed session price with a small package that includes feedback. Separate preparation, delivery and follow-up costs. Define what is excluded before testing the offer with eligible customers. Record objections and actual decisions. Proposed prices remain hypotheses until costs and purchasing behaviour have been verified.
